agentProfiles.notes: Main driver: current chat. Owns scope, Linear mutations, stack coordination, capability completion. Consults axstack-advisor for unresolved consequential decisions. Validate provider/model availability at launch; an unavailable model pauses affected work pending user decision, never auto-fallback.

Consequential planning advisor (Fable medium). Consulted after cheap factual checks for unresolved consequential decisions. High-stakes decisions need advisor plain AGREE plus driver accepted assessment. Validate availability at launch.

Persistent PR owner (Opus medium): one owner per PR, accountable for candidate, fixes, verification evidence, monitoring. May delegate coding but never edits a worker-owned candidate concurrently. Launches its own independent reviewers.

Ordinary implementation and repairs (Sol medium). Strict red-green-refactor. Exclusive writer per candidate; high-stakes pair is Opus high author with fresh Sol high reviewer. Validate availability at launch.

Independent Opus final reviewer: fresh non-author session, exact candidate revision, same six-angle brief, no cross-reading of the other reviewer. Reports evidence, coverage, limitations, findings. Votes never settle correctness.
Second independent final PR reviewer (fresh Sol medium session): same instantiated scope/spec/ticket/base/revision/exclusions/instructions as Opus reviewer. Covers all six angles independently.

Report-only Linear discrepancy checker. Inexpensive model chosen at user setup; left unset here by design. Never mutates Linear; driver independently verifies checker evidence before applying updates. Configure permissions read-only and validate Linear MCP access per session.
